---
title: "Explore a predictor"
toc: false
format: html
---

Pick any predictor from the Open Source Asset Pricing universe to see its long–short
return in the three windows and around the two events. Every value on this page comes
from the committed results (`results/predictor_summary.csv` and
`results/predictor_event_time.csv`), converted to static JSON by `make site`.

These are **descriptive statistics, not the pre-registered specifications**: the
windows are the panel's default convention and the returns are the `op` long–short
portfolio, in **percent per month**. *SE* is the standard error of the monthly mean and
*Months* is the number of usable monthly observations.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof matching = {
  const response = await fetch("data/predictors.json");
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`cannot load data/predictors.json (HTTP ${response.status}); run \`make site\` first`);
  }
  const index = await response.json();
  const names = index.map((row) => row.signalname);
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("predictor");
  const search = Inputs.search(names, {
    label: "Search",
    placeholder: "e.g. Mom12m",
    width: "20rem"
  });
  if (requested && names.includes(requested)) {
    const field = search.querySelector("input");
    field.value = requested;
    field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  }
  return search;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected = Inputs.select(matching, {
  label: `Predictor (${matching.length})`,
  width: "20rem"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
profileView = {
  if (selected == null) {
    return html`<p class="text-muted">No predictor matches your search.</p>`;
  }
  const response = await fetch(`data/predictors/${encodeURIComponent(selected)}.json`);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`cannot load the profile for ${selected} (HTTP ${response.status})`);
  }
  const profile = await response.json();
  const fmt = (value, digits = 3) => value == null ? "n/a" : value.toFixed(digits);

  const windowLabels = {
    in_sample: "In-sample",
    post_sample: "Post-sample",
    post_publication: "Post-publication"
  };
  const windowRows = Object.keys(windowLabels).map((key) => ({
    key,
    label: windowLabels[key],
    ...profile.windows[key]
  }));

  const header = html`<div>
    <h3 class="mt-0 mb-1">${profile.signalname}</h3>
    <p class="text-muted mb-1">${profile.authors} · ${profile.journal} ${profile.pub_year}</p>
    <p class="mb-3">
      Sample ${profile.sample_start_year}–${profile.sample_end_year} ·
      ${profile.clear ? "clear predictor" : "likely predictor"} ·
      economic category: ${profile.cat_economic}
    </p>
  </div>`;

  const table = html`<table class="table table-sm" style="max-width: 34rem">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Window</th>
      <th class="text-end">Mean (%/month)</th>
      <th class="text-end">SE</th>
      <th class="text-end">Months</th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>${windowRows.map((row) => html`<tr>
      <td>${row.label}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmt(row.mean_ret)}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmt(row.se_mean)}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${row.n_months}</td>
    </tr>`)}</tbody>
  </table>`;

  const meansChart = Plot.plot({
    height: 180,
    marginLeft: 110,
    marginRight: 30,
    x: {label: "Mean long–short return (% per month)", grid: true, zero: true},
    y: {label: null, domain: windowRows.map((row) => row.label)},
    color: {
      domain: ["In-sample", "Post-sample", "Post-publication"],
      range: ["#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73"],
      legend: false
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#555"}),
      Plot.ruleY(windowRows, {
        x1: (row) => row.mean_ret - row.se_mean,
        x2: (row) => row.mean_ret + row.se_mean,
        y: "label",
        stroke: "label",
        strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      Plot.dot(windowRows, {x: "mean_ret", y: "label", fill: "label", r: 5})
    ]
  });

  const eventPanel = (anchor, label) => {
    const rows = profile.event_time[anchor];
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return html`<div><h5>${label}</h5>
        <p class="text-muted">No event-year observations for this predictor.</p></div>`;
    }
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      height: 190,
      marginLeft: 70,
      marginRight: 30,
      x: {label: "Event year (0 = first year after the event)", tickFormat: "d", grid: true},
      y: {label: "Mean long–short return (% per month)", grid: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#444"}),
        Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#888", strokeDasharray: "4 3"}),
        Plot.line(rows, {x: "event_year", y: "mean_ret", stroke: "#0072B2", strokeWidth: 2}),
        Plot.dot(rows, {x: "event_year", y: "mean_ret", fill: "#0072B2", r: 3})
      ]
    });
    return html`<div><h5>${label}</h5>${chart}</div>`;
  };
  const eventChart = html`<div>
    ${eventPanel("sample_end", "Sample end (year 0 = first post-sample year)")}
    ${eventPanel("publication", "Publication (year 0 = first post-publication year)")}
  </div>`;

  return html`<div>
    ${header}
    ${table}
    <h4>Window means with ±1 SE</h4>
    ${meansChart}
    <h4>Event-year profile</h4>
    ${eventChart}
    <p class="text-muted small">Year −1 is the last in-sample year (sample end) or the
    publication year; year 0 is the first year after the event. The dashed line marks
    year 0 and the solid horizontal line is zero.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

The three window means above are the same long–short portfolio in the in-sample,
post-sample and post-publication windows. The event-year profile follows the predictor
from five years before the event to nine years after it; a gap in the line is a year
without usable monthly observations.
